requirements.title: EXPONENT returns the model exponent for representable nonzero finite X
requirements.definition: For nonzero X whose model exponent is within default integer range, EXPONENT returns the exponent e of X in the extended real model for the kind of X.

pending.exponent-nonzero-model-exponent: Use exact model-derived inputs such as SET_EXPONENT(FRACTION(1.0_kind), 3) or RADIX-derived values so the expected exponent is known from the model, not from decimal approximation.
pending.exponent-negative-uses-value-exponent: Include a negative input constructed with the same model exponent as a positive control and assert the same returned exponent, preventing sign-sensitive mutations.
pending.exponent-different-kinds: Repeat the model-derived checks for default real and double precision real; the kind mutation changes the declared kind and the expected KIND-independent exponent remains model-derived.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9.79-16.9.85: ERF, ERFC, ERFC_SCALED, EVENT_QUERY, EXECUTE_COMMAND_LINE, EXP and EXPONENT (batch190). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; EVENT_QUERY runtime facets are out of scope because event variables are coarrays; EXECUTE_COMMAND_LINE's assignment obligations are split from the processor-dependent values and text, with a guarded CMDMSG-unchanged plan; EXPONENT's result kind is checked on the expression and its IEEE special cases are guarded plans. Source accounting only.
